text: Return canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, and exact activity values (type, relation, value, units) for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613797. Select canonical_smiles, molecule chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: assays, activities, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: assays to activities on assay_id, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter: assays.chembl_id equals CHEMBL1613797. No deduplication.
